case: Sunday: "this week" asked on the week's last day is the coming week

parts.quote: What is on for the family this week?

answers.text: This week includes Practise reading for Leo on Monday, 19 October, Parents' evening for Mara and Tom on Tuesday, 20 October at 18:00–19:00, Sign the school trip form for Mara on Tuesday, 20 October, Football training for Ivy on Wednesday, 21 October at 17:00–18:00, Swimming lesson for Leo on Thursday, 22 October at 16:30–17:30, Piano lesson for Ivy on Thursday, 22 October at 18:00–19:00, Dinner at Nona Marija's on Friday, 23 October at 18:30–21:00, and U13 match, Olimpija for Ivy on Saturday, 24 October at 10:00–11:00.
